title: Debounce a search box
why_it_matters: Firing a request on every keystroke wastes data and flickers.
explanation: Debouncing waits until the user stops typing for a short moment before running your function. Each new keystroke cancels the previous timer. 300 milliseconds is a common starting point. It keeps API calls and rendering under control.
try_it: Wrap a search handler in debounce and watch the network tab.
